Hi Elena / Jonas,

Thanks — I prepared a quick proforma and a VAT guidance note (attached). Summary below; full calculation is in the attached proforma_midcycle_capacity.pdf.

Summary of proration and invoice approach:
- Billing cycle: monthly, calendar month (1st–31st). Your current committed pool is billed on the 1st of the month.
- Burst window: 2026-08-15 00:00 UTC through 2026-08-20 23:59 UTC (6 days).
- Proration basis: we prorate the incremental capacity charge by days in the month. For August (31 days) a 6-day burst = 6/31 of the burst rate.

Numbers (example):
- Burst rate (incremental): $1,200 / day (this is the rate we quoted for ephemeral 30k tokens/min bump)
- 6 days x $1,200 = $7,200 gross charge
- Prorated to month fraction (already daily priced) = $7,200 one-time line item on Aug invoice

VAT handling and reverse-charge:
- You provided VAT ID: IT12345678901 — we confirm Medivax S.r.l. is a taxable person in the EU.
- Redwood (legal entity providing the service on this invoice) will be the Redwood US entity (US TAX ID on file). For EU B2B supplies of services, reverse-charge can apply; we will issue the invoice without VAT and include the reverse-charge statement.
- Invoice will include: your VAT ID, our VAT reference (if applicable), the text: "VAT reverse-charge applies – Art. 194 of Council Directive 2006/112/EC" and the PO number. Please confirm if your accounting requires a different clause.

Invoice & delivery:
- We will add a single one-time line item ("Aug 15–20 capacity burst") on the Aug invoice due Net 30 by default.
- Billing to: billing@medivax.it per your preference.

Next steps / items we need from you:
1) Confirm PO number to appear on the invoice (PO_9862 confirmed in your email?).
2) Confirm VAT ID shown exactly as: IT12345678901.
3) If you need the invoice to show any specific GL or cost center, provide that string.

Attachments: proforma_midcycle_capacity.pdf (breakdown by day + ledger line), vat_reverse_charge_guidance.pdf (short note for your tax team).

Once you confirm the three items above we will: schedule the burst (Jonas will handle infra), generate the proforma as an official invoice stub, and then emit the Aug invoice with the one-time charge.
